description: This lot includes assorted mineral specimens: two polished agate slabs and one rough sodalite stone. The polished slabs feature blue-gray coloration with semi-translucent chalcedony areas, typical of blue agate. The rough stone displays a deep blue crystalline structure with a white matrix and dark inclusions, consistent with sodalite or lapis lazuli. Each piece is medium-sized, approximately palm-sized. The slabs have smooth, polished faces and natural rough backs. No brand or manufacturer markings. Suitable for collectors, educational use, or lapidary projects.

description: Educational Rocks and Minerals kit by Tangerine Press, Scholastic Inc., 2013. Suitable for ages 7 and up. Includes a 32-page book explaining rock formation and details on various rocks and minerals. Contains nine real mineral specimens: Tiger Eye, Unakite, Red Jasper, Rhodonite, Lemon Jade, Crystal Quartz, Dalmatian Jasper, Amazonite, and Amethyst. Each mineral is displayed in a clear plastic case. Outer packaging and book show used condition with visible wear but no major damage. Mineral samples appear intact. Ideal for young collectors and educational use. 9x6

Order/Listing questions and issues
Due to our high volume of sales, please allow up to 3 business days for us to respond to your message.

shipping.policy:
Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

Amethyst and Rose Quartz Crystal Collection
Natural Stone Clusters and Points
Largest piece approx. 3.5" x 3"; Total weight 1.5 lbs
Unsigned
This diverse collection features a variety of natural mineral specimens, highlighted by a substantial amethyst druzy cluster with a characteristic dark, possibly copper or silicate-rich matrix. The lot includes six individual pieces showcasing different geological formations, including deep violet amethyst clusters, translucent rose quartz, and raw crystal points. The pieces demonstrate a beautiful range of color saturation and crystalline structures, making them excellent examples for geological study or natural home decor.

Includes 6 individual pieces consisting of amethyst clusters, points, and rose quartz

Condition:
Very good natural condition. These are raw mineral specimens and feature natural inclusions, terminations, and matrix variations inherent to their formation. The crystal points are largely intact with expected minor abrasions consistent with raw extraction. No evidence of artificial dyes or repairs.
This is a pre-owned item donated to Goodwill of Northern Michigan.
